items.source: Gets published when an entity is about to get deleted.
items.translation: 在实体即将被删除时发布。

items.source: change - the AggregateChange containing the planned actions to be performed on the database.
items.translation: change - 包含对数据库计划执行的操作的 AggregateChange。

items.source: id - the id of the entity. Must not be null.
items.translation: id - 实体的 ID。不能为 null。

items.source: entity - the entity about to get deleted. May be null.
items.translation: entity - 即将被删除的实体。可能为 null。
